d:
Bihar ki rajniti men anant sinh ke bete ki or se niraj kumar ko shadi ka nimantran bheje jane ki tasvir soshal midiya par vayral ho rahi hai. ab is vayral tasvir par niraj kumar ne saphaee di hai. unhonne ise puri tarah bhramak batate hue kaha ki soshal midiya par prasarit kiya ja raha aamantran kard sahi nahin hai. niraj kumar ne logon se apil ki hai ki kisi bhi suchna ya nimantran ki satyata ki pushti kie bina use sajha na karen. aakhir vayral tasvir ki asliyat kya hai?
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
